name: ci-helpers/php-vuln-fixture
description: Pinned to a release with published advisories so `composer audit` can be shown to fail. 7.4.0 rather than 6.x: 6.x requires php <8. Composer 2.9 refuses to resolve this at all unless policy.advisories.block is turned off, which the leg does -- the case the audit stage exists for is a composer.lock written while its packages were clean, which installs without resolving. Do not bump it.
